content:
The long-awaited "Ted Lasso" (《足球女將》) has finally returned, with the premiere episode of the show's fourth season now available for subscribers on Apple TV+.

"Ted Lasso" is finally back

More than three years after the third season finale, the first episode of the fourth season is now streaming on Apple TV+ for viewers to watch.

Apple has heavily promoted the show's return, including arranging a surprise appearance by Jason Sudeikis and Brendan Hunt as coaches Ted and Beard during the World Cup final, and will host a lookalike contest this Thursday (August 6) at the Apple Fifth Avenue Plaza in New York.

If you've successfully avoided all the spoilers about the show's return and want to keep it that way, we recommend skipping straight to the main point and watching the premiere now. However, if you don't mind getting a general sense of the season's direction ahead of time, here's a synopsis of the new season provided by Apple TV+:

"Ted Lasso" season 4 has a total of 10 episodes and will run until October 7, 2026, and is expected to be the first season of a new three-season run.

Most of the main cast will return, with new additions including Tanya Reynolds (previously seen in "Underdogs") and Paloma Cinco (previously seen in "De La Cruz"), who is the biological sister of Cristo Fernandez. Cristo Fernandez plays the beloved Dani Rojas in the show and has since transitioned to becoming a professional footballer.

Watch the trailer for the new season of "Ted Lasso" below:

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month and is also included in the Apple One bundle subscription. The platform features many popular series and films, such as "Severance", "The Studio", "The Morning Show", "Shrinking", and "Silo".
